title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study C)
description: Study C of the bigP3BCI collection provides EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants using a 6x6 checkerboard P300 speller paradigm with error-related negativity (ERN). Data were recorded from 32 channels at 256 Hz with a g.USBamp amplifier and include target and non-target visual stimulus events annotated with HED. The dataset supports machine learning benchmarking of P300-based brain-computer interface classification.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier from 32 channels at 256 Hz in a laboratory setting (60 Hz line frequency, standard 10-20 montage). Participants used a P300 speller with a 6x6 checkerboard paradigm and online feedback, with a calibration-then-test design. Epochs span 0-1.0 s after stimulus onset.
